target.title: Fix Gemini helper timeout reliability
target.body:
## Summary

- Resolve `fnm` from the active environment PATH before falling back to the login-shell PATH.
- Make synchronous Gemini package-discovery waits independent of termination-handler callback scheduling.
- Close parent pipe writers after launch and return after the first complete line, even when descendants inherit stdout.
- Preserve monotonic deadlines and hard process-group termination for stuck helpers.
- Give the growing macOS test matrix 45-minute job / 40-minute test-step headroom.
- Document the user-visible reliability fix in the changelog.

## Proof

- `swift test --filter GeminiStatusProbeAPITests` — 19 tests passed on the final local head.
- The inherited-stdout regression returns while a separate 30-second stdout holder is still alive; the ignored-SIGTERM regression proves escalation to SIGKILL.
- `make check` — repository guards, links, locale parity, SwiftFormat, and SwiftLint passed; 0 lint violations across 1,246 files.
- Installed `fnm` live path — `fnm current` returned `v25.8.1` in 0.00s and `fnm exec --using v25.8.1 npm root -g` returned the global root in 0.10s; no Gemini credential read or provider request was needed.
- Autoreview — clean, no accepted/actionable findings (0.82 confidence).

## Risk

Low. Runtime changes remain scoped to Gemini package discovery plus a reusable first-line pipe-capture primitive. The helper stays synchronous and bounded, escalates to hard process-group termination after deadline, and has direct success, no-output failure, inherited-pipe, active-PATH, and ignored-SIGTERM coverage.
